_meta.source: Korea public data portal — daily index series (archive/raw/indices)
_meta.nameEnNote: English names come from the same mapping /v1/index-tape uses, never invented here. An index with no mapping carries name_en:null rather than a transliteration.
_meta.notIndexTape: This endpoint is the dated history. /v1/index-tape is a single most-recent snapshot with English names and base-date fields. They are built from the same well but answer different questions.
_meta.yearLowNote: The source prints 0 for a year-low it has not measured. A zero is impossible for an index, so those rows carry year_low:null with year_low_not_measured:true — never a low of zero.
_meta.notThis: These are published index levels, reproduced as filed. Not a forecast and not advice.
